reply_text: I replied in the #north-team thread. There's no settled 2026 seat count I can confirm. The account page shows 185 active seats and mentions Amendment No. 3 taking seats to 230 on 2027-01-01, so those don't reconcile with 261. I suggested she check with Ilse or June before the tracker gets a number.
